# tarpeg007 — Saad Fellahi, offensive security

> Saad Fellahi (tarpeg007) is a penetration tester and offensive security researcher: 6 CVE credits in JavaScript frameworks, a CVSS 9.1 critical accepted on HackerOne, HTB CPTS & CBBH certified, based in Casablanca-Settat, Morocco. The site covers web/API penetration testing, source code review, authentication and access-control testing (IDOR, BOLA, OAuth, JWT), bug bounty hunting, and pre-launch security testing.

## Pages

- [Portfolio homepage](https://tarpeg007.github.io/): CVE record, bounty log, offensive-testing arsenal, experience.
- [Security writing index](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/): in-depth security-testing guides (20 articles).
- [How to Use Security Test Resources Before Web Launch](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/security-testing-before-web-launch/): A practical pre-launch web app security testing playbook that maps OWASP WSTG scenarios to ASVS controls, exposes real risk, and produces retestable evidence.
- [Which bug bounty providers fit your appsec scope?](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/bug-bounty-providers-appsec-scope/): Choose a bug bounty or application security testing provider by matching scope, tester access, triage, SLAs and retesting to the risk your application faces.
- [Best Web App Penetration Testing Providers Compared](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/web-app-pentesting-providers-compared/): Compare web app penetration testing providers by methodology, API and access-control depth, reporting, retesting, and fit—so your team can buy confidently.
- [Which offensive security consulting fits startups best?](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/offensive-security-consulting-startups/): Choose startup offensive security consulting with a scope matrix for web, API, cloud, AppSec, red-team, and continuous testing, plus provider-buying criteria.
- [How Can You Detect and Validate SSRF in Your Apps?](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/can-you-detect-validate-ssrf-apps/): Learn a safe, evidence-led workflow to find, confirm, report, and fix SSRF flaws using controlled callbacks, URL controls, egress rules, and retests now.
- [How to Test OAuth/OIDC Security Step by Step](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/test-oauthoidc-security-step-by-step/): Follow a practical OAuth/OIDC security testing workflow: validate PKCE, redirects, tokens, JWKS, API boundaries, negative cases, and capture evidence.
- [How to security-test JWT authentication end to end](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/security-test-jwt-authentication-end-end/): Learn how to test JWT authentication end to end: model trust boundaries, validate signatures and claims, exercise JWKS rotation, and automate regressions.
- [How to Test CSRF Risk in OAuth and Sessions](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/test-csrf-risk-oauth-sessions/): Learn a practical way to test CSRF risk in OAuth and sessions: verify state, PKCE, SameSite cookies, callback integrity, and safe fixes.
- [Manual pentesting vs DAST: what do you actually get?](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/manual-pentesting-dast-do-you-actually-get/): Manual pentesting vs DAST: compare coverage, access control, evidence quality, reporting, and retests—so you know what you’ll actually get.
- [API vs Web App Penetration Testing: Key Differences](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/api-web-app-penetration-testing-key-differences/): Compare API and web app penetration-testing scopes, from identity and business logic to browser behavior, tools, evidence, and risk-prioritized reporting.
- [How to Procure an External Penetration Test Service](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/procure-external-penetration-test-service/): Learn how to procure an external penetration test: set scope, compare providers, define safe Rules of Engagement, review findings, plan retests.
- [How to Reliably Identify BOLA in Real APIs](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/reliably-identify-bola-real-apis/): Learn a repeatable, safe method to find BOLA in live APIs: map objects, compare two identities, run negative tests, cover GraphQL, and verify fixes reliably.
- [How to Perform an Authorized XSS Assessment Safely](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/perform-authorized-xss-assessment-safely/): Plan authorized XSS testing with clear scope, safe validation, and reproducible reporting. Covers reflected, stored, DOM-based XSS, remediation, CSP, and OWASP.
- [Which vulnerability research services fit your team?](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/vulnerability-research-services-fit-team/): Choose vulnerability research services by product risk, access, and fix capacity. Compare specialist, platform, and internal options—use our scope checklist.
- [Which API security tools and vendors to test APIs](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/api-security-tools-vendors-test-apis/): Compare API security testing vendors, DAST, fuzzing, contract tests, BOLA checks, CI/CD gates and pentests using an evidence-led evaluation scorecard.
- [How to Test Web Apps for IDOR With Repeatable Steps](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/test-web-apps-idor-repeatable-steps/): Learn a repeatable, authorized IDOR test process: map access rules, swap safe object IDs, validate server denials, document evidence, fix policies, and retest.
- [Which providers offer black-box web testing?](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/providers-offer-black-box-web-testing/): Compare black-box web testing providers: consultancies, PTaaS, crowdsourced teams, and automation. Select right scope, evidence, reporting, and retest terms.
- [Which trusted providers excel at secure code review?](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/trusted-providers-excel-at-secure-code-review/): Compare trusted secure code review providers by expert depth, methodology, tool validation, evidence, remediation quality, and fit for your AppSec risk.
- [Bug Bounty vs Penetration Testing: Key Differences](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/bug-bounty-penetration-testing-key-differences/): Compare bug bounty programs and penetration tests by scope, speed, cost, coverage, triage, reporting, and retesting—then choose the right mix for your risk.
- [Which firms offer API penetration testing services?](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/firms-offer-api-penetration-testing-services/): Choose an API penetration testing firm with a practical comparison of specialist, PTaaS and enterprise options, plus scope, evidence and retest criteria.
